description:
## Problem
BenchBox has none of the specification's audit (Appendix A), batch-validation (Appendix B) or visibility (Appendix C) SQL, and no TPC-DI licence files. The Databricks project's audit is its own rewrite (42 of 126 tests differ from the TPC text, one with an alias bug) and must not be used.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21)
- 2026-11-20: "Ship them in BenchBox under EULA clause 9 (include the EULA and the required legend, charge no fee)." and "Proceed on the reviewer's reading of clause 9; no gate."
- 2026-11-20: "The legend 'THE TPC SOFTWARE IS AVAILABLE WITHOUT CHARGE FROM TPC.' is line 1 of a NOTICE.txt beside the shipped TPC-DI files and appears in the README's licence section."
- 2026-11-21, audit SQL: "Ship the official TPC text from the archive you supply, unmodified; only the substitutions the specification allows, recorded in the result."
- 2026-11-21, comment policy: new `external` entries for the TPC-DI files are "Approved in advance for the TPC-DI files only, with the soundness review."

## Change
Add `_sources/tpc-di/` and `benchbox/_binaries/tpc-di/` with EULA.txt (byte-identical to the archive's), NOTICE.txt (legend on line 1) and the unmodified `tpcdi_audit.sql`, `tpcdi_validation.sql`, `tpcdi_visibility_1.sql`, `tpcdi_visibility_2.sql` taken from the official Appendix archive; SHA256MANIFEST, MANIFEST.in and the `external` entries in `quality/comment-policy.json`; a TPC-DI section in `_sources/README.md` with each archive's name and SHA-256; the README licence section; extend `tests/unit/core/test_tpc_notices.py`. Add `benchbox/core/tpcdi/appendix.py`: it loads the shipped SQL, applies only the minor substitutions the specification permits (3.4.11.1.1, for example the dummy-table clause and the concatenation operator) for a named platform, and returns the list applied. Record in the provenance file the SHA-256 of the Databricks project's copy of each appendix file next to the official one, and whether they are identical.

## Decision gates
Owner action first: the owner places the official `TPC-DI_Tools_v1.1.0.zip` and the separate Appendix archive (specification page 117) under `~/Developer/tpc-tools/`. This item stays blocked until both are there. The archives are never committed as archives. Take the files only from the official archives. If the Appendix archive lacks any of the four files, or its EULA differs from `_sources/tpc-h/EULA.txt` in a way that affects clause 9, stop and report. If any appendix statement does not bind on DuckDB with minor substitutions only, stop and report the statement; do not edit the file. The `external` policy entries are approved in advance for these files only; anything wider stops.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the four SQL files and the EULA in the wheel equal the archive members byte for byte (SHA-256 in the pull request); line 1 of NOTICE.txt equals the legend; `uv build --wheel && unzip -l dist/benchbox-*.whl | rg 'tpc-di/'` lists them; the notices test passes and fails if the legend is removed; loader tests show the recorded substitutions and that the stored files are untouched; every statement of Appendix A, B and C parses and binds against step 7's empty schema on DuckDB with only the recorded substitutions (a test); `make comment-policy-check` and `make pr-preflight` pass; the soundness review of the head is a success.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
- Sources. SQL derived from the Databricks project (`src/incremental_batches/**` at commit 8e0f944, treated as MIT on the owner's instruction) may be committed only after the provenance step has merged, only under `benchbox/core/tpcdi/etl/`, with every file listed in `PROVENANCE.json` and with all comments removed.
- TPC and bankmark files (DIGen, PDGF, dictionaries, configuration, EULA, appendix SQL) come only from the official archive the owner supplies, are committed unmodified and only in the directories named in the tools step. Never copy from the Databricks project or the DuckDB implementation: their copies of the tools or the tools zip, DIGen output, generated reference files, audit snapshots, their copy or rewrite of the appendix SQL, or any generator code (`src/tools/**`). Never commit DIGen output.
- The specification wins over the Databricks project without asking. Each behaviour of the project that is kept and each change made to follow the specification is one row in `benchbox/core/tpcdi/etl/DEPARTURES.yaml`, which the owner approves at the milestone stop.
- A difference from the DuckDB implementation (djouallah/tpcdi) that is not in the written list of expected differences is a finding: it is triaged and listed in the pull request before the step is armed.
- Staging files produced by DIGen are never edited. The official audit, validation and visibility SQL is never edited in the repository.
